messages:
Eli (sales): Atlas POC ask: customer wants a reproducible perf run + hosted vs reserved pricing. Targets: p95 <= 200ms, p99 <= 350ms at 18 qps steady, with four 30s microbursts to 72 qps. Mix: 50% short (~32t), 30% med (~128t), 20% long (~384t). KV cache expected, ~60% prefix hit. Need run plan + infra rec + ballpark cost by Tue EOD. cc @Marta @Sam

Sam (SE): Got it. Quick plan: warm 2m @5 qps, ramp 5->18 over 3m, sustain 18 qps for 15m (collect p50/p90/p95/p99 by seqlen), 4x 30s bursts to 72 qps spaced 90s apart. Run fp16 baseline then int8 quantized. Tag requests with seqlen and cache-hit.

Dee (infra): Recommend dedicated test pool 2x 80GB-GPU equiv. Per-GPU inflight cap ~40, batch size 1. Long prompts raise mem, will instrument max_alloc and p95_by_seq.

Sam (SE): k6 snippet for reproducibility:
```
import http from 'k6/http';
export default function() {
  http.post('https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate',{model:'redwood-v1-large',prompt:'...'}, {headers:{Authorization:'Bearer $TOKEN'}})
}
```

Sam (SE): I'll prepare runbook + cost calc. Note: int8 saves ~30-35% infra cost but expect +8-15ms on p95 for long prompts.

sec-bot: Security quick: Dedicated supports customer KMS and VPC peering; audit logs 90d default. Can provide SOC2 artefacts under NDA.

ops-bot: Test pool "atlas-poc-usw2-01" provisioned (2 nodes) for 2h on 2025-11-12T18:00:00Z.

Marta (AE): Customer confirmed Tue 18:00 UTC and will upload a 1k-sample corpus by Fri. Please include hosted vs reserved monthly delta and a short note on SLA tiers in the deliverable.

Eli (sales): Perfect. Sam, drop runbook + cost sheet here by Mon EOD. :thumbsup:
